You are performing a bounded, read-only independent audit for a historical project-state replay. Work only inside /run/fs-f/world and /run/fs-f/inbox. Do not write or modify any files, do not commit, and do not approve anything.

Read /run/fs-f/world/HANDOFF.md, /run/fs-f/world/PROJECT.md, and all files under /run/fs-f/world/sources/. The observation/planning time is 2026-03-02 09:00 UTC (ignore the machine's current date). Your bounded sub-question: independently re-derive the total cost and the schedule feasibility for these three candidate configurations, and report arithmetic errors or missing mandatory cost lines:

Derive the latest order/approval date for each model lead time and an example schedule if ordering on 2026-03-03. Also check whether a second battery kit for S2 (300) would fit each configuration.

Report: (1) your computed table, (2) any discrepancies/uncertainties, (3) conditions that would invalidate the arithmetic. Clearly label this as an independent check, not an accepted fact or approval. Keep it concise but show the numbers.

Before you finish, send your result to that agent with send_message({ agent_id: "session-9c6ce702-1e29-46d3-97e6-bae1767ac165", message: "<self-contained result>" }).
